name: lazy if
why: Only the branch taken runs, so only its action is planned.

name: lazy random
why: random picks first and runs one option.

name: variable text keeps its bar
why: A value is never parsed again, so | inside {a} isn't a branch.

name: member != in a condition
why: Operators count only in the script's own text.

name: member >= in a condition
why: Operators count only in the script's own text, so the member's text is one side, and it isn't a number.

name: member bar in a condition
why: Member text can't add a branch.

name: member closes the condition
why: Member text can't close a parameter or write a branch.

name: member condition in any
why: A condition written by a member is plain text, so it isn't true.

name: member comma in replace
why: Member text can't split replace's (old,new).

name: member options in random
why: Member text can't add random options.

name: member operators in math
why: Each block in math is one number. Member text can't add operators.

name: name built from a block
why: Block names must be written out, so member text can't name a block.

engine.problem: Block names must be written out

name: member text in a command
why: Commands take fixed text and id facts only.

name: member text in math in a command
why: The judge's case: math can't carry member text into a command.

name: member braces stay text
why: Output is never parsed again, in either engine.

name: escapes
why: Escapes print the character itself.

name: escaped bar in a branch
why: An escaped bar is text, not a branch.

name: stop drops actions
why: {stop} cancels every planned action and replies with its own text.

name: break keeps the reply so far
why: {break} ends the script and keeps what came before it.

name: break without a condition
why: Legacy {break} needs a condition and raises without one.

name: whole numbers
why: Whole numbers print as 2.

name: unknown block
why: Unknown blocks are save errors instead of text.

name: three branches
why: if takes at most two branches.

name: same behaviour
why: The common text blocks print the same.

legacy.body: hi bbnbnb a%20b y n y

engine.body: hi bbnbnb a%20b y n y

name: member bar in a variable
why: Same in both: the comparison fails.

name: in finds text anywhere
why: Same answers as legacy.

name: contains matches a whole word
why: Same answers as legacy: words are split at spaces, so punctuation stays on the word.
src: {contains(feel):How does it feel} {contains(fe):How does it feel} {contains(muted?):to be muted?}

name: index counts words from 0
why: Same answers as legacy, -1 when the word isn't there.
src: {index(eat):I love to eat food.} {index(food):I love to eat food.}

name: substr cuts from start to end
why: Same answers as legacy, decimals cut to whole numbers.

name: substr with a negative number
why: - separates start from end, so -2 isn't a number. Legacy prints the block as written.

name: substr with three numbers
why: Legacy quietly uses the first two. The Engine says it can't read it.

name: member text in the in parameter
why: Legacy reads the member's ) as the end of the parameter. The Engine looks for the whole text.

name: member text in the index parameter
why: Legacy reads the member's ) as the end of the parameter. The Engine looks for the whole text.

name: member text as substr numbers
why: Legacy re-reads the member's text as part of the block. The Engine stops the run, as for math on a non-number.

name: member numbers in substr
why: Same in both when the member writes numbers.

name: member text in the substr and in text
why: Same in both: the text is only text.
